blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers most of the frontier with few false positives by 30%.
blocks.zh: LLM代理工作流程越来越多地为专门角色采用不同的模式. 用户可能倾向于在任务质量和部署费用之间作出不同的权衡,有时也考虑暂时性。 寻找好工作需要与评价多个候选人分开寻找费用。 我们引入了成本计算基廷斯(CC-Gittins),这是对Pareto建议进行单一目标成本认识基廷斯搜索的多目标扩展. 它利用了评价与部署费用之间的结合:部署费用较高的任务也为评价费用高。 搜索在寻求质量更高和部署费用更低之间替代,重新利用每次评价为两次搜索提供信息。 每批之后,CC-Gittins建议在对质量和部署费用进行不确定性调整的估计数下进行非主导性的任务。 我们评价CC-Gittins从工作流程中得出的8个质量成本矩阵,其中2至5个角色,最多1 681个候选人。 我们还将这种方法作为第三个目标来评估。 在八项基准中,CC-Gittins以详尽评估成本的10%左右回收了真实帕雷托边疆的一大部分,并以很少的假阳性回收了大部分边疆。

Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine multiple interacting
roles, such as planning, solving, searching, and verification ( Hua et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Users may want to compare the task quality of inexpensive and more costly assignments before choosing what to deploy. A representative range of quality–cost trade-offs can support this decision without requiring every Pareto-optimal assignment to be identified.

blocks.en: Existing methods either report quality–cost frontiers over evaluated agent assignments (TeamBench, AgentCARD, and AgentOpt) ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Hua et al., 2026 ) , or optimize a specified objective or constraint. In particular, AgentOpt reduces multi-objective search to single-objective optimization using a fixed weighted-sum utility ( Hua et al., 2026 ) , SCOPE minimizes deployment cost subject to a quality threshold ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and VineLM adapts model choices at individual invocations under cost or latency budgets ( Pagonas et al., 2026 ) . We study anytime recommendation of complete role assignments through costly evaluations, without fixing the preferred trade-off or final search cost in advance.

blocks.en: We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins ( CC-Gittins ), a multi-objective method for anytime Pareto recommendation that exploits this coupling. For quality and cost, two search policies, called controllers , take turns choosing evaluations: one seeks higher quality and the other lower deployment cost. The quality controller prices further evaluation using configuration-specific API costs. In the simplified model of Section 3.4 , its Gittins indices rank assignments by quality minus a deployment-cost penalty, so relaxing the evaluation-price multiplier can favor different quality–cost trade-offs. The controllers share observations. After each batch, assignments nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted quality and deployment-cost estimates form the recommendation. Figure 2 gives an overview.

blocks.en: 1.1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en: Server-side systems improve scheduling, memory use, and serving throughput ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . Client-side routing selects a model per request or call ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ) . Agent configuration search instead assigns models to interacting roles and observes an end-to-end trajectory reward. TeamBench exhaustively studies the assignments of several providers to Planner, Executor, and Verifier ( Kim et al., 2026 ) , while AgentCARD maps deployment-aware cost–accuracy frontiers over multi-role assignments ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . These systems characterize configuration landscapes after evaluation.

blocks.en: General-purpose multi-objective bandits study Pareto-set identification under fixed-confidence or fixed-budget objectives ( Kone et al., 2023 ; Kone et al., 2024 ) . Hypervolume-based Bayesian optimization, including qEHVI and qNEHVI, selects evaluations by expected hypervolume improvement ( Daulton et al., 2020 ; Daulton et al., 2021 ) . These methods can be sample-efficient, but their standard acquisition criterion does not explicitly price the assignment-dependent API cost of each evaluation. CC-Gittins includes that price in its scalar indices and updates its recommendation after each batch; we assess those recommendations at matched cumulative API spend.

blocks.en:
Our goal is to progressively identify model assignments
with different quality–cost trade-offs while minimizing
evaluation costs. To achieve this, CC-Gittins uses
two controllers, one focusing on quality and the other
on deployment cost. The controllers take turns selecting
assignments for evaluation and share their observations.
After each evaluation batch, we update the recommended
assignments based on Pareto dominance.
We next explain how the controllers select evaluations
and how the recommendations are constructed.

blocks.en: Our quality–cost evaluation uses eight exhaustive or replay-complete matrices across five workflow families. We evaluate 10 2 = 100 10^{2}=100 assignments on all 200 questions of each of HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) (planner and search-enabled solver) and MathQA ( Amini et al., 2019 ) (answerer and critic). Their ten candidate models use AWS Bedrock Application Inference Profiles; Appendix D.2 lists invocation prices. Six further instances use SCOPE’s released query-level evaluations ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , covering three-to-five-role text-to-SQL, data-transformation, and data-integration workflows. These configurations form subsets of the nominal assignment spaces, each evaluated on every benchmark question. All methods replay the same complete score–cost matrices (Appendix D.1 ).

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: CC-Gittins exploits the coupling between deployment and evaluation costs for anytime multi-objective Pareto recommendation. Across eight quality–cost benchmarks, it recovers substantial portions of the exhaustive Pareto frontier at low evaluation cost. Experiments including latency also demonstrate applicability to three-objective Pareto recommendation.

blocks.en: We consider static role-level assignments under fixed orchestration. Complete frontier recovery is not guaranteed, and controller design remains empirical. Future work could adapt model choices, retries, and execution paths to intermediate outcomes.

blocks.en: All five baselines use the same frozen response matrices but follow their own sampling protocols; checkpoints are aligned by realized cumulative API search cost. EGE-SH allocates observations in rounds and uses empirical Pareto gaps to halve the active assignments ( Kone et al., 2024 ) . We use the confidence-bound sampling rule of APE- k k to direct observations toward uncertain Pareto comparisons; its fixed-confidence stopping condition is disabled, and sampling continues until the replay observation cap is reached or available observations are exhausted ( Kone et al., 2023 ) . qNEHVI uses a Bayesian surrogate over categorical assignment features and chooses evaluations by noisy expected hypervolume improvement ( Daulton et al., 2021 ) .

Its mean runtime reaches 6.2 hours on Restaurant Valid, 10.4 hours on BIRD Mini Dev, and 22.5 hours on Bing Query Logs, compared with 1.1, 3.6, and 3.0 minutes for CC-Gittins , respectively. CC-Gittins has a mean runtime below 3.6 minutes on every benchmark. EGE-SH and APE- k k also remain below 18 minutes, while the two random baselines finish in approximately 8–14 seconds. These results show that qNEHVI’s computational overhead becomes the dominant cost as the configuration matrix grows.

blocks.en: Figure 14 shows that extra directions redistribute evaluation effort rather than uniformly improving the recommendation. Intermediate controllers can concentrate evidence on a compact set of high-value trade-offs, improving dominated-volume recovery and recommendation proximity while weakening uniform frontier coverage. The one-axis controls show the benefit of retaining both endpoint-oriented controllers, while adding directions does not mechanically enlarge the final set because all controllers share observations and a common conservative recommendation rule forms the returned set. The frontier-metric curves compare variants at matched fractions of exhaustive API evaluation cost, whereas the runtime experiment fixes the number of evaluated matrix entries at ⌈ 0.30 ​ K ​ N ⌉ \lceil 0.30KN\rceil , where K K is the number of configurations and N N is the number of questions in the benchmark matrix. The latter measures policy computation at equal evaluation counts rather than equal search cost. Including the single-direction controls, the runtime experiment covers five settings (Fig. 15 ). G0 has lower mean policy runtime than both denser direction sets on all eight benchmarks. Averaging per-benchmark runtime ratios, G5 and G6 require 1.39 × \times and 1.74 × \times G0’s policy time, respectively. Together with the frontier-quality controls, these results support the two-axis configuration as a trade-off between frontier recovery and policy computation.

G0的平均政策运行时间低于所有8个基准上两个更密集的方向。 按基准计算运行时间比率,G5和G6需要1.39xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 分别为G0的政策时间. 这些成果与前沿质量控制一道,支持两轴配置,作为边境恢复与政策计算之间的权衡。

blocks.en: Figure 16 compares G0’s independent direction-local relaxation with the fixed- η \eta no-stop control G7. In G0, a local stopping signal triggers a reduction of the visited controller’s information-price multiplier when possible, allowing configurations whose value of information was marginal at an earlier price scale to become eligible for further evaluation. G7 instead retains the initial price scale and continues without a Gittins stop. G0 achieves lower aggregate mean HV regret, GD, and IGD at the 30% checkpoint. These results support the relaxation mechanism for improving volume recovery and frontier coverage while maintaining competitive recommendation proximity; the gains vary across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图16 G0的独立方向 - 局部放松与固定的 -\\eta不停止控制G7. 在G0中,局部的停止信号在可能时触发了被访问控制器信息价格乘数的降低,使得其信息价值在早期价格尺度上微乎其微的配置有资格得到进一步评价. 而G7则保留了最初的物价尺度,并在没有吉丁斯停机的情况下继续. G0实现较低的总和,平均HV遗憾,GD,以及30%检查点的IGD. 这些结果支持了在保持竞争性建议接近性的同时改善数量回收和前沿覆盖的放松机制;收益因基准而异。

blocks.en: Figure 17 shows that controller order affects recommendation quality at matched cumulative search cost: a sequential policy allocates early evaluations to its first controller and postpones evidence about the opposite frontier extreme. Round-robin scheduling instead balances directional attention from the outset, while shared observations allow every purchased batch to inform both controllers. This combination exposes both endpoints early enough for their evidence to shape the interior recommendation, making interleaving more robust than draining either axis first.
blocks.zh: 图17显示,控制器命令以相应的累积搜索成本影响建议质量:一个顺序政策将早期评价分配给其第一个控制器,并推迟关于相反前沿极端的证据. 相反,回合-robin排期从一开始就平衡了方向注意力,而共同的观察则允许每个购买的批次通知两个控制器. 这种组合使得两个终点都提前暴露,使得它们的证据能够塑造内部建议,使得交叉比先排出两个轴线更坚固.

blocks.en: Figure 19 separates acquisition pricing from controller choice. G1 versus G7, G4 versus G8, and G0 versus G9 compare real with unit prices while retaining observed deployment costs, the Pareto recommendation rule, and realized-dollar accounting. Real pricing improves volume recovery and recommendation proximity for the multi-controller variants on both matrices, while coverage gains remain benchmark-dependent. These controls support cost-aware acquisition without implying that lower HV regret and GD guarantee better frontier coverage.
blocks.zh: 图19将购置定价与控制器选择分开。 G1对G7、G4对G8、G0对G9对实际价格进行比较,同时保留观察到的部署费用、帕雷托建议规则以及实值会计。 实际定价提高了两个矩阵上多控制器变体的物量回收率和建议的接近性,而覆盖范围的增益仍然取决于基准。 这些控制措施支持成本意识的获取,但并不意味着HV的遗憾程度较低,而且GD保证了更好的前沿覆盖。

blocks.en: Figure 20 shows that additional directions redistribute evaluation effort rather than uniformly improving the recommendation. All controllers observe the same three outcomes, which a common recommendation rule uses to form the returned set. G4 interleaves the three pure axes; G0 adds the Q–L midpoint with radial utility min ⁡ { Q i , ℓ i } \min\{Q_{i},\ell_{i}\} . G5 combines the Q–L endpoints, quarter points, and midpoint with the D axis; G6 combines the three axes with the Q–L, L–D, and Q–D midpoints. Round-robin scheduling balances decision opportunities, not purchased batches or dollars. Multi-controller search improves volume recovery over the single-direction controls. The three-edge geometry helps on HotpotQA, while pure axes remain competitive on MathQA; adding the Q–L midpoint can improve early coverage without retaining that advantage at later cost checkpoints. The preferred geometry therefore depends on the benchmark, cumulative search cost, and frontier metric.
blocks.zh: 图20显示,其他方向重新分配评价工作,而不是统一改进建议。 所有控制器都遵守相同的三个结果,一个共同的推荐规则用来组成返回的集合. G4与三根纯轴相交;G0与射线功用min {Qi,li}}\ell_{i}\ell_{i}\G5结合了QQL终点,四分之一点,中间点与D轴;G6将三根轴与QQL,L-D,和QQD中点结合. 回合制的列表平衡决策机会,不购买批次或美元. 多控制器搜索比单向控制改善了体积回收. 热点QA的三面几何帮助,而纯轴在MathQA上仍然具有竞争力;加上QQL中点可以改善早期的覆盖,而不会在后来的成本检查站保留这一优势. 因此,首选的几何学取决于基准、累积搜索成本和边框度量。

blocks.en: Figure 21 compares policy computation at an equal number of evaluated entries. All tested direction sets have mean runtimes on the same tens-of-seconds scale, with G0 remaining within this range on both matrices. Together with G0’s strong hypervolume recovery and low GD (Figure 20 ), this modest computational overhead motivates our choice of four directions as the main configuration for the three-objective experiments.
blocks.zh: 图21比较了相同数目的评价条目中的政策计算。 所有经过测试的方向集在相同的数十秒尺度上都有平均运行时间,G0在两个矩阵上都保持在这个范围内. 再加上G0的强超量回收和低GD(图20),这种微小的计算间接费用促使我们选择四个方向作为三个目标实验的主要配置.

blocks.en: Figure 22 compares G0’s independent direction-local relaxation with fixed-price continuation G10 under the same four controllers and round-robin schedule. Relaxation can favor early volume recovery or recommendation proximity, but fixed-price continuation provides better frontier coverage at the final reported checkpoint on both matrices. The coverage benefit observed in the two-objective ablation therefore does not transfer uniformly to three objectives; the continuation policy requires a separate empirical assessment.
blocks.zh: 图22 G0的独立方向-局部放松,固定价格续作G10,采用相同的四个控制器和圆旋动表. 放松可以有利于早日恢复总量或接近建议,但固定价格的继续提供两个矩阵上最后报告的检查站的更好的前沿覆盖。 因此,在两个目标范围内观察到的覆盖范围效益不能统一转移到三个目标;继续政策需要单独的实证评估。
